evidence.rationale: The full RosterView renders every coworker as a rich card — measured at 2902 words on arrival, 6x the 450-word net-new absolute budget. A visible lean name list still failed net-new: 25 un-punctuated names spike Flesch-Kincaid to grade 38.8 (high-school cap is 9, measured over all default-visible prose). Final design matches the compliant net-new pattern (/platform/archetype-readiness): a data-dpf-lead header with plain high-school-grade copy and a data-owner-first-next-action marker, with the whole searchable RosterView deferred behind a collapsed OwnerFirstDisclosure (excised from both the word count and the reading grade). Arrival is a calm ~45-word summary that names the count and the next action; the rich directory is one click away. This deferral is the progressive disclosure the epic is about.
